title: Splitting a sign assignment
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and $P\subseteq[n]$. Restriction to $P$ and to $[n]\setminus P$ gives a bijection from sign assignments on $[n]$ to pairs consisting of a sign assignment on $P$ and a sign assignment on $[n]\setminus P$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a set of coordinates in $[n]$
